# Mumei Agent

> Mumei Agent is an AI-driven autonomous verification and self-healing loop for the Mumei proof-driven programming language. It combines LLM inference (Ollama/OpenAI/DashScope) with Z3 formal verification to automatically detect and fix code issues.

## What Mumei Agent does

- Validates existing Python/Rust/Go code by inferring and verifying contracts
- Detects spec↔code drift between natural-language requirements and implementations
- Finds contradictions in natural-language specifications
- Self-heals `.mm` files using an LLM + Z3 retry loop
- Runs as an MCP server for integration with Claude Code, Devin, and other AI agents

## Key links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/mumei-lang/mumei-agent)
- [Verification Workflow Guide](https://github.com/mumei-lang/mumei-agent/blob/develop/docs/VERIFICATION_WORKFLOW_GUIDE.md)
- [Mumei Compiler](https://github.com/mumei-lang/mumei)

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mumei-lang/mumei-agent
cd mumei-agent
cp .env.example .env
uv sync
uv run mumei-agent validate-code --input src/payment.py --language python
```
